newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Shotover Jet says sticking to jet boating.
newsitem.headline: Shotover Jet says sticking to jet boating.

text.p: Shotover Jet Ltd said on Friday it was returning to its core focus of jetboating operations.
The company said it would re-engineer its balance sheet and sell its non core Rotorua-based businesses, Rainbow Springs and Rainbow Farm show.
It would implement a five-year business plan which aimed to maximise returns from remaining core businesses and eventually eliminate debt.

Earlier, the tourism company recorded a trading surplus for the March year of NZ$974,000, but after write downs in balance sheet values of $4.9 million, the net result for the year was a loss of $3.9 million.
The company said the result should be treated as an interim one as it was changing its balance date to June 30 to spread its trading more equitably.
Note - Shotover Jet Limited is a tourist operator.
